textRuns.value: Round 4 added Customers, Reviews and Web Traffic, fixed an ALLSELECTED bug in Seasonality Index, an ambiguous relationship path through Reviews, and a backwards relationship direction on 3 relationships. Round 5 merged the two Customer pages into one and stretched detail-row charts to fill the page instead of leaving dead space. Round 6 added a custom colour theme and chart variety. Round 7 fixed an unexplained promo-channel blank bar and inconsistent captions. Round 8 added a real SKU-level overstock exception table. Round 9 moved Site Traffic onto the Customers page without resizing any canvas. See BUILD_LOG.md for the full log.
